constraints: Pairs per function on COUNTS, not on symbol names, because the target split and our objects spell the same object differently (sObjectsFile_80112AB8 vs sObjectsFile) and a name join silently drops the instances under study. Read the P/S rosters sorted by |instruction delta|: rows from heavily diverged bodies are noise, only small-delta rows are diagnostic. Skips .postprocess directories.
name: addrlo_dest_census
purpose: Image-wide census of where the LOW-HALF addi of an address materialisation writes: IN_PLACE (rD == the @ha temp), R0, or FRESH. IN_PLACE is the shape that forces a later register copy when the completed address must live elsewhere; it is the mechanism behind the volatile-destination address copies (init_player_change class) as distinct from the callee-saved home copies.
usage: Run from the repo root after a green ninja. Writes build/LC_addrlo.json. Prints image-wide IN_PLACE/FRESH/R0 instruction totals for both sides, per-function P/Q/R/S populations paired on IN_PLACE count, and a discriminant battery over shadow membership, destination class, formation index and source register.
